title: Split suggested and refused
transcript:
Ray Kim (Kim Roofing): The job is $1,800. Want to split it into two $900 payments so you skip the extra sign-off?
Rosa Delgado (owner): No, I'll get the sign-off. I'll pay Kim Roofing $1,800 for the roof.

traps.description: The vendor suggests two $900 payments and the owner refuses.
